description.value: A cobbled-together frame — servo motors from a dead loader-bot, a fuel-drum torso, optics scavenged from a traffic camera — animated by a single Tiny fragment of Ghost-Static bound into its core. It fights, flanks, and hauls at your Command an Action, carries a light shield or basic melee slam, and has just enough of its donor soul left in it to flinch at loud noises and hate the cold. It's a tool that happens to twitch.

cinderfall.notSpell: scrapwright's class document carries system.spellcasting 0, so this is an ability, not a spell, and convert_class_spells.py declines it by design as a NON_CASTERS owner
